envelope.home: tmpfs seeded from the harness HOME (read-only mount + relay copy)
envelope.network: none; the mock is a mounted unix socket

checks.name: whole_cores
checks.detail: every SMT sibling of a bench CPU is in the bench or mock set (or the CPU has none)

checks.name: housekeeping
checks.detail: 104 online CPUs are left for everything else

checks.name: one_numa_node
checks.detail: bench and mock CPUs are on NUMA node(s) [0]

checks.name: fixed_clock
checks.detail: governor is performance or the clock is fixed

checks.name: no_cpu_quota
checks.detail: no cgroup from the benchmark up to the root limits CPU time

checks.name: quota_covers_the_cpus
checks.detail: no quota is smaller than the CPUs the benchmark uses

checks.name: exclusive_cpus
checks.detail: the site declares the host dedicated and no other thread was running on the bench CPUs when looked at (a claim, not a guarantee)

perf.reason: the container envelope starts the harness through the container runtime: no counter is attached to its tree, so CPU time is the headline for this run

site.name: smc1-socket0
site.notes: Intel Xeon Platinum 8462Y+, 2 sockets. The benchmark uses 5 whole cores of socket 0 (harness 8-11 with SMT siblings 72-75, runner and mock 12 with 76); the rest of socket 0 is idle; socket 1 runs unrelated development work. Governor performance and turbo off for the run.

reasons: 6 samples waited for the host to quiet down (longest 2 s) and 0 gave up waiting
